name: IB Infotech Enterprises Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1987, IB Infotech Enterprises Ltd is in the business of IT & IT relates services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
IBIEL provides IT-enabled services and is also engaged in trading agricultural produce.
a) The company manufactures and deals in various IT products, including computers, printers, hardware, software, web design, hosting, IT services, medical and legal transcriptions, data management, e-commerce, and enterprise solutions.
b) It also focuses on manufacturing, developing, and trading IT-related services, electronics, wireless applications, telecommunications, mobile/satellite phones, media, and advertising.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 51.3%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.79 times its book value
